exp: Three-distance theorem: for any α and N, the N points {kα} (k=0,…,N-1) partition the unit circle into N arcs of exactly 2 or 3 distinct lengths. The three lengths are determined by the continued fraction expansion of α. This is a remarkable uniformity result for irrational rotations.
